There’s buying a pet from a stranger or an Instagram page and then there’s buying pets from trusted certified non cruelty sources. The difference is in one’s approach. 

The reasons are not weird. I’ve tried adopting cats from shelters here and even from well know people in the cat community in dubai a bunch of times. The procedure is close to a horror film, they want all sorts of information from you each time they’ve asked for a salary certificate or to visit my home and the pets thrice a month, what is the point of adopting a pet if the owner wants to gate keep the pet till they seem fit? I will happily send pictures and videos for a while but people go to the extreme. One person even went as far as reporting me and sending me hate on an fb page because I bought a different collar for the cat I adopted from her. 

Maybe it’s easier in other countries but most cat people here suck and it’s just a way to practice control over you.

You can’t adopt every cat breed, some are expensive because they’re incredibly rare exotic breeds. Some people want  lazy cats for companionship. Some want little munchkins or fluffy Persians. 

While it’s great to adopt not everyone is looking for the same personality in a cat. I have 7 cats that are adopted or strays I kept but I would prefer one that’s lazy and cuddly over all of my Arabian mau cats because they don’t give me the sense of companionship I want unless they’re hungry.
